rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin (spot)
positions.catalyst: Sunday, US equity markets closed → spot crypto only (leveraged crypto ETFs trade equity hours only). Supportive-but-cautious tape: US spot BTC ETFs logged a 5th straight day of inflows (~$850M cumulative since Aug 3), an active institutional bid under price; offset by risk-off sentiment (Crypto Fear & Greed 39). BTC pinned ~$64.9k, ETH ~$1,919, SOL ~$76 (+1.8%). No fresh next-24h catalyst strong enough for a high-beta bet.
positions.driver: LONG BTC spot, 100% capital, no leverage (crypto weekend). On a low-edge, fear-territory weekend the objective favors the most defensive spot expression with the best downside protection: BTC is the lowest-vol major, holds the $63-65k shelf, and now has a concrete tailwind — 5 consecutive days of spot-BTC-ETF inflows (~$850M) providing a real institutional bid. Chose BTC over: SOL (genuine catalysts — Western Union selecting Solana for stablecoin settlement across 150M+ customers, plus Anza SIMD-0525 slot-time upgrade — but the upgrade mainnet-activates the week of Aug 17, NOT next-24h, and SOL is higher-beta into fear sentiment = more weekend downside); ETH (range-bound ~$1,919, no fresh 24h catalyst, mid-beta). Entry 64939.19 = dashboard live proxy quote, asOf 2026-08-09T11:40:58Z. Stop 58445.27 (-10%, spot-crypto band).
positions.risks: Weekend crypto liquidity is thin with no circuit breakers, so a risk-off deepening (macro/geopolitical headline) can gap BTC through $63k support sharply. ETF-inflow support is a weekday-market dynamic and does not backstop weekend price directly. Opportunity cost if SOL front-runs its catalysts or a risk-on reversal favors higher-beta alts. Mitigants: -10% hard stop caps loss; BTC is the least-volatile major (structural downside protection vs alts); daily rotation caps the hold to ~24h; spot sizing (no leverage amplification).
